title: All polyhedral graphs with at most 16 vertices are Schurian: a computational verification
summary: Li, Ponomarenko and Zeman state their belief that every polyhedral graph (i.e. every $3$-connected planar graph) is Schurian: that its coherent closure $WL(X)$ coincides with the orbital configuration of $Aut(X)$. Combined with their Theorem 1.1, this would imply that every polyhedral graph has Weisfeiler-Leman dimension at most $2$. We report a computational verification of the Schurian property for all polyhedral graphs with at most $16$ vertices, a total of 413,024,847,068 graphs, none of which is non-Schurian.
